weapon.d: Calculates damage from staff like other weapons. Reduces damage from foes' attacks during combat to allies within 2 spaces by 30%.

assist.d: Restores 7 HP to unit and target ally.

Restores 8 HP to target ally. Unit moves 1 space away from target ally. Ally moves to unit's previous space.
If unit or ally cannot move to the target space (if another ally or foe is occupying the space), unit and ally will not move. Using this skill has no effect on Special cooldown charge and unit does not gain EXP or SP. (This skill is treated as a movement skill only when movement takes place.)

Restores HP = 50% of unit's Atk (min 8 HP) to target ally. Unit moves 1 space away from target ally. Ally moves to unit's previous space.
If unit or ally cannot move to the target space (if another ally or foe is occupying the space), unit and ally will not move. Using this skill has no effect on Special cooldown charge and unit does not gain EXP or SP. (This skill is treated as a movement skill only when movement takes place.)

special.d: When healing an ally with a staff, restores an additional 10 HP to target ally.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Res+4 to all allies for 1 turn.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Spd/Res+4 to all allies for 1 turn.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Spd/Res+6 to all allies for 1 turn.

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, foe cannot counterattack.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, foe cannot counterattack.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit's HP = 100%, grants the following status to adjacent infantry, armored, and cavalry allies for 1 turn: "Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces."
At start of turn, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, grants the following status to adjacent infantry, armored, and cavalry allies for 1 turn: "Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces."
